1013
# core/test-support Sandbox (about 180 lines) is the harness these tests pin: every koi a test starts holds the sandbox's lifeline, stops when the test ends or its process dies, and must stay inside the sandbox root.
# sandbox.rs a_koi_stops_when_its_sandbox_drops_after_its_test_passes_or_panics: a daemon a test starts is gone when its Sandbox drops, after a pass and after a panic.
# sandbox.rs a_koi_stops_when_the_test_process_that_started_it_is_killed: a daemon outlives no SIGKILLed test process.
# sandbox.rs a_test_cannot_run_koi_outside_its_sandbox: a koi under the lifeline exits 78 when HOME (the account's, a symlink to it, a .. path to it, or an unrelated directory), its state, config or runtime directory, the install inventory (/ or a .. escape whose uninstall would delete an app) or HOMEBREW_PREFIX (real or symlinked) lies outside the canonical sandbox root, and its uninstall leaves an app reached through an Applications symlink planted in the sandbox untouched.
# sandbox.rs a_koi_outside_a_sandbox_cannot_start: process::koi refuses a directory that no Sandbox owns.
# sandbox.rs every_program_a_test_runs_that_could_start_koi_is_sandboxed: a lint over cli/tests and the ffi daemon tests that rejects any koi spawn not routed through sandboxed().
# sandbox.rs a_sweep_removes_only_an_abandoned_tree_a_sandbox_made: a sweep leaves a tree named by a lifeline outside its parent directory, by a lifeline other accounts can write, or by a lifeline whose koi still runs, and removes an abandoned one.
# update/installer.rs koi_update_never_runs_an_installed_koi_outside_its_sandbox: after the installer runs, a test koi's update refuses to probe an installed koi that resolves outside the sandbox.
# uninstall.rs a_test_koi_never_runs_a_brew_outside_its_sandbox: a test koi's uninstall never runs a Homebrew whose bin/brew resolves outside the sandbox.
# sandbox.rs another_test_process_leaves_a_sandbox_whole_while_it_ends: one test process's sweep of abandoned lifelines never removes another live process's sandbox.
# daemon_status.rs a_test_profile_in_the_default_layout_never_takes_the_account_s_service_name: a koi under the lifeline takes a suffixed launchd label or systemd unit, never the account's own.
# daemon_status.rs a_default_profile_outside_the_account_s_home_takes_the_bare_service_name_outside_a_test: without the lifeline, a HOME other than the passwd home keeps the bare dev.koidrive.koi or koidrive.service name, as for real users.
# daemon_status.rs the_service_a_test_installs_stops_with_the_test: the launch agent or unit a test installs carries the sandbox HOME, the lifeline and the install inventory, and has launchd or systemd restart its koi only after a failure. The test reads the written definition and starts no service.
# server/common.rs Machine keeps HOME and the runtime directory side by side inside its sandbox, so the systemd service tests reach the user manager and the uninstall test's listing of HOME shows only what koi left.
# sandbox.rs every_program_koi_starts_goes_through_its_program_runner (a syn visitor, about 320 lines) checks routing, not the sandbox itself: cli/src reaches std or tokio process::Command only inside crate::program, under any import name, uses configured_async only in program.rs and app_install's control.rs, and passes a path to a program only as program::Confined, never as text. The sandbox check happens at run time: found and found_async check the program, and Confined::new checks each path. system, system_async and configured_async start trusted tools (fixed OS paths such as /usr/bin/git, launchctl, or app_install's configured tools) without a program check. The lint fails on a direct, renamed, self-aliased or globbed process::Command, on a configured_async import outside its two files, on a runner function that returns a raw Command, and on a stringified path passed as an argument directly or through a local binding. It skips code under cfg(test) or cfg(all(test, ..)) and test directories inside src.
# update/homebrew.rs koi_update_never_pulls_a_homebrew_tap_outside_its_sandbox: koi update refuses to start Homebrew's git in a tap checkout that brew names outside the sandbox.
# update/homebrew.rs koi_update_never_refreshes_a_tap_with_a_git_outside_its_sandbox: without a git beside the sandbox's brew, koi update refuses the tap refresh instead of running /usr/bin/git, so a tap config that names an outside program never runs it.
# update/homebrew.rs koi_update_never_runs_a_homebrew_koi_outside_its_sandbox: koi update reaches brew upgrade and never probes or reconciles a Homebrew koi whose opt link leads outside the sandbox.
# update/status.rs the_daemon_never_hands_its_service_to_a_koi_outside_its_sandbox: a released daemon's scan for a newer koi skips an installed koi that leads outside the sandbox and hands the service to the newest koi inside it.
# No existing test kills a test process, checks what outlives a test, or checks which service name or paths a test koi may use, so none of these duplicates another.
